title: YetiWatch Signal Payload
description: Per projection-row news synthesis emitted by the YetiWatch news job. The projection engine consumes this; the `news_string` is mirrored into the projections page `news` column. One object per (player, game) per pre-game run. All availability/production fields reflect an ORIGINAL synthesis across multiple sources — never redistributed source text.

run_id.description: Identifier of the pre-game news run that produced this record. Lets the engine match the news run to the projection run it feeds.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this synthesis was generated. Drives the timestamp shown in news_string and the freshness metric.

player_id.description: Canonical WNBA player id (join key to the projection row).

player_name.description: Display name (for readability/debugging; not a join key).

team_id.description: Canonical WNBA team id for the player.

game_id.description: Canonical game id (join key to the projection row).

opponent_id.description: Canonical team id of the opponent.

game_start.description: Scheduled tip-off, ISO 8601. Used for cadence/lock logic.

status.description: Synthesized availability designation, aligned to the WNBA official injury-report scale. 'not_reported' = no report yet / no material item found.

availability_prob.description: Synthesized probability the player suits up and plays a normal role. Lets the projection engine weight the row rather than treat status as binary. Null if genuinely unknown.

minutes_outlook.description: Expected minutes effect. cap_min and delta_min are independent: a return-from-injury cap sets cap_min; a softer expectation sets delta_min.

cap_min.description: Hard minutes ceiling if the player is on an explicit restriction (e.g., 22). Null if no cap.

delta_min.description: Expected change in minutes vs baseline, in minutes (can be negative). Null if no expected change.

note.description: Short original note on the minutes situation. Null if none.

usage_delta.description: Expected change in this player's usage/role share, driven e.g. by teammate availability or role change.

usage_delta_factor.description: Optional numeric multiplier on baseline usage (e.g., 1.15 = +15%). Null if expressed only categorically.

signal_types.description: Taxonomy tags describing what kind(s) of news this is. Empty array = no material signal.

impact.description: Production-relative impact summary. Direction/magnitude are relative to the player's OWN expected output, not any bet side.

direction.description: Expected effect on the player's projected production.

magnitude.description: Size of the expected effect. Use 'low' when direction is neutral/unknown.

confidence.description: 0-1, driven by cross-source corroboration x signal clarity. Multiple credible sources agreeing -> high; single low-tier or conflicting -> low.

rationale.description: One-line original explanation. Null if neutral with nothing to say.

related_subjects.description: Other players whose situation drives THIS row (e.g., a teammate ruled out that raises this player's usage). Lets the engine trace cause.

news_string.description: Original synthesized column string. Format: '<summary> [impact tag] <as-of time>'. Impact tag is '[prod ↓ <mag>]' or '[prod ↑ <mag>]' for up/down, else '[neutral]' or '[unknown]'. Explicit neutral state required (never blank). Original wording only — no source text.

provenance.description: Synthesis metadata only — no raw source text is stored or republished.

source_count.description: How many distinct sources contributed to this synthesis.

latest_source_ts.description: Timestamp of the most recent contributing item, ISO 8601.

minutes_outlook.note: On a minutes cap returning from ankle.

impact.rationale: Minutes capped on return, usage unchanged, so counting stats project lower.

examples.news_string: Min cap ~22 on return from ankle; usage steady. [prod ↓ med] 5:40p ET

minutes_outlook.note: Likely more on-ball reps with starter out.

impact.rationale: Primary scorer ruled out for rest; usage and minutes project up.

examples.news_string: Star teammate out (rest, B2B); usage projects up. [prod ↑ med] 4:12p ET
Full participant, no concern across reports. [neutral] 3:00p ET
